nodes.name: Client Form Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives POST from landing page contact form. Expected fields: company_name, contact_name, contact_email, phone, contract_size, employee_count, ai_systems (comma-separated), primary_agency, compliance_concerns, timeline

nodes.name: Create Client Record
nodes.notes: Creates the client record in the compliance database.

nodes.name: Run Initial Assessment
nodes.notes: Triggers the compliance agent to run an initial gap scan for the new client.
